name.title: Household Name
name.description: The household's name, for example The Garcia Family.

formalGreeting.title: Formal Greeting
formalGreeting.description: How a letter to the household is addressed, for example Ms. Maria Garcia and Mr. Wei Lee.

informalGreeting.title: Informal Greeting
informalGreeting.description: How the household is greeted informally, for example Maria and Wei.

memberCount.title: Member Count
memberCount.description: How many people currently belong to the household.

primaryContactName.title: Primary Contact Name
primaryContactName.description: The name of the household's primary contact, the person mail and calls go to first. Empty when none is set.

mailingAddress.title: Mailing Address
mailingAddress.description: The household's current mailing address on one line: street, city, state, postal code and country. Empty when none is recorded.

members.title: Members
members.description: The people who currently belong to the household, the primary member first.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Empty when the household was found. Otherwise why not, in plain words to show the user.
